name: MuAViC
description: We introduce MuAViC, a multilingual audio-visual corpus for robust speech recognition and robust speech-to-text translation providing 1200 hours of audio-visual speech in 9 languages. It is fully transcribed and covers 6 English-to-X translation as well as 6 X-to-English translation directions. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first open benchmark for audio-visual speech-to-text translation and the largest open benchmark for multilingual audio-visual speech recognition. Our baseline results show that MuAViC is effective for building noise-robust speech recognition and translation models. We make the corpus available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/muavic.
reputation: A notable open benchmark in multilingual audio-visual speech processing, especially valued for combining speech recognition and translation across multiple languages.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; results are usually reported with WER and BLEU across multiple language directions, and performance varies substantially by language and modality availability.
